title: tld elements.yaml
description: Workspace element definitions for the tld / tlDiagram CLI. Each top-level key is an element ref: a stable, lowercase identifier used by connectors and placements to reference the element. The `root` ref is reserved for the synthetic workspace root view and may only be used as a placement/view parent.

elementRef.description: Element reference. Must start with a lowercase letter or digit and may contain lowercase letters, digits, dots, underscores, and hyphens. `root` is reserved for the synthetic workspace root and cannot be used as an element ref.

parentRef.description: Parent/view reference. Same character rules as an element ref, plus the reserved value `root` for the synthetic workspace root.

viewPlacement.description: Places the containing element inside another element's internal view (or the root view when parent is `root`).

position_x.description: X coordinate within the parent view. Omitted coordinates are auto-laid-out by the frontend.

position_y.description: Y coordinate within the parent view. Omitted coordinates are auto-laid-out by the frontend.

visibility_delta.description: Density/noise-gate adjustment applied to this placement relative to the parent view.

element.description: A single element (node) in the workspace. `name` and `kind` are required by the CLI validator.

name.description: Human-readable element name shown on the diagram.

kind.description: Element kind/category. Free-form lowercase token used for icon and default styling (e.g. service, database, queue, cache). Defaults to `service` when created through the CLI.

owner.description: Registered repository key from `repositories` in .tld.yaml. When set, the CLI validates that the owner is a known repository.

description.description: Long-form description of the element's responsibility.

technology.description: Primary technology label (e.g. Go, React, Postgres).

url.description: External link to documentation, repo, or runbook.

logo_url.description: Override logo/icon URL or catalog slug. May be a relative path or a technology slug.

repo.description: Repository identifier this element lives in (e.g. an owner/name slug).

repository_id.description: Identifier of the indexed codeindex repository this element is linked to. When set, `repo`/`file_path` are resolved against that repository's local checkout.

branch.description: Repository branch associated with this element.

file_path.description: Source file path within the repo for code-linked elements. When combined with `symbol`, the CLI verifies the symbol exists.

symbol.description: Named code symbol within `file_path` (e.g. a function or type name). Verified by `tld validate` when the file is accessible.

tags.description: Free-form labels used for filtering and visual grouping.

has_view.description: Whether this element owns an internal (child) view/diagram. Defaults to false.

view_name.description: Optional internal name for the child view.

view_label.description: Label shown for a drill-down into this element's child view (e.g. Container, Component).

density_level.description: Noise-gate density level for this element's internal view. Higher values reveal more detail.

bypass_noise_gate.description: When true, this element is always shown regardless of the view's density level.

placements.description: Where this element appears across views. A source element placed in multiple parent views has one entry per parent.
